reason: Reviewed lifecycle-hook guidance, the Notifai skill and its references, harness setup, CLI readiness, and domain/trust terms against Claude Code session titles. Claude Code reports a session's custom title on its SessionStart and UserPromptSubmit hooks when the User named the session. Notifai now keeps that title and uses it as the environment-supplied Agent Session name, after an exact Orca pane title and before the agent's own label, as it already does for Codex thread titles. A generated or folder-derived Claude Code name is never reported on those hooks and is never used. A subagent callback does not name the session. The skill already says the initial name comes from the environment when available, then the agent's label, then a generated fallback, and that changing the label flag does not rename an existing semantic name. No command, flag, setup step, trust decision or agent obligation changes, so no guidance edit is required.
